about: Lou's lines for the demo video, in order; written by Meta's Muse Spark from our brief (4 Nov), except 'honest', the founder's own. Press ] for the next, [ for the previous.

cues.text: Friends, our hour of destiny has arrived. Welcome to my fab, where we will end the world's memory shortage.
Destiny demands more memory, but my fab is too slow. Wafers queue in lines while good machines stand idle.
With all lots bound to the same machines and rails, who goes next for the empire, and shall rush prototypes jump the line?
Given these rails and the wafers pouring in, where shall each tool stand in my empire?
We set the industry's best practices, dude!
I will show you my empire fab in person, then we will watch my finest films together in my cinema hall.
My friends, our empire of memory awaits your dreams, so let us build onward together.
